channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Julius Randle | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Julius Randle from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Chris Finch on Julius Randle, Rudy Gobert, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Chris Finch:

“I felt that going into Game 6, we tried to make some adjustments that were clearly not right. I kicked myself for doing it, just because I felt we didn't probably need to be as extreme. I flipped the matchups around. We put Rudy Gobert on Castle, and we started with Julius Randle on Victor Wembanyama, trying to mitigate Wembanyama's hot starts. We did a good job, but then Castle got loose on us. It wasn't a scheme that we were overly comfortable with. We've done it from time to time, and it maybe just wouldn't have been the time to do it.”

Chris Finch on Julius Randle, Rudy Gobert, Victor Wembanyama, Jun 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Paul Pierce on James Posey, Julius Randle, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Paul Pierce says the Timberwolves lack leadership:

“Not to say that Anthony Edwards is not a leader or Julius Randle. But I also think when you trying to win a championship there is got to be somebody in that locker room that everybody respects that’s been to the promised land, to help you. Like, for us we had veterans Ray,KG, myself but we didn’t win a championship. Having James Posey in that locker room who won a championship was important for us. And I think that’s the one piece they’re missing a guy that’s been around the block, that’s like look guys it’s playoffs time and lock in and practice habits right now, a lot of little things.”

Paul Pierce on James Posey, Julius Randle, Anthony Edwards, Mar 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Julius Randle, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jamal Murray, Alex Caruso
item.description:
LeBron James:

“And then (the Thunder) come off the bench with one of my favorite teammates of all time, Alex Caruso, who is like the dog. He's the ultimate Swiss Army knife. We've literally seen him guard Giannis. We've seen him guard the Joker. You know, we've seen him guard Ant, we've seen him guard Julius Randle, we've seen him guard Jamal Murray throughout this whole postseason.”

LeBron James on Julius Randle, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jamal Murray, Alex Caruso, Jun 4, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Nickeil Alexander-Walker
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Tim Connelly on Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Naz Reid and Julius Randle:

“We’re very appreciative of what the market might look like. We’re pretty cautiously optimistic we’re in a good place with all of the guys. Most importantly, they want to be here.”

Tim Connelly on Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Jun 2, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Julius Randle
item.description:
Steve Kerr:

“Julius Randle was incredible. What a series…I think he’s taken a leap.”

Steve Kerr on Julius Randle, May 15, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kevon Looney on Julius Randle, Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Kevon Looney on the physicality vs Gobert:

“Last series I feel like was way worse than anything I did last game. It’s the playoffs. I’m gonna grab and push until they call it. Rudy’s a great rebounder. Randle…Everybody got their own little tricks they do.”

Kevon Looney on Julius Randle, Rudy Gobert, May 7, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Josh Hart on Julius Randle, Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
“We’re going to compare ourselves to last year, for what? We don’t got Donte, we don’t got [Isaiah Hartenstein], we don’t got [Julius Randle].… We don’t have any of those guys. And now we got a totally different group and a totally different personality.”

Josh Hart on Julius Randle, Isaiah Hartenstein, Apr 27, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Suns coach Mike Budenholzer on strategy with Rudy Gobert (back) out:

“Hopefully our guys are aggressive. If there's opportunities to get to the paint, finish. Opportunities on the offensive boards. If it's (Julius) Randle and (Naz) Reid or whoever their backup bigs are, make them have to move and guard the pick-and-roll. Just be aggressive, attacking, just generally speaking but also make an effort to get to the offensive boards some too.”

Mike Budenholzer on Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Rudy Gobert, Mar 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Julius Randle
item.description:
“They're just sensitive and they're terrible. They penalize me and Ju (Randle) for being stronger than our opponent every night. We don't get no calls. So yeah, that's how I feel about the officials. Every game that we play.”

Anthony Edwards on Julius Randle, Dec 22, 2024. Source: athlonsports.com.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Julius Randle
item.description:
“We know I'm gonna shoot a bunch of shots, we know Ju [Julius Randle] gonna shoot a bunch of shots, and that's all we know. We don't really know anything else. It's not on the coaches at all. It's on us. We're out there playing.”

Anthony Edwards on Julius Randle, Dec 20, 2024. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
“I think Julius is more of a power forward, but a terrific player. When you look at what he did for us, the scoring, the passing, rebounding, but it’s at the power forward position. “We had a great need obviously with Mitchell Robinson [injured] and Isaiah [Hartenstein] losing [him] in free agency. We needed a center. That was a big part of it, so I think the center position … when I look at Karl, I like his versatility and his size is important to us.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Mitchell Robinson, Oct 14, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Paul George on Julius Randle
item.description:
George said.

“Karl is awful! He’s old. That was a bad trade to give up Julius for Kat! I’m kidding. Obviously, Kat is one of my closest friends. Kat is a good touch. I think it’s a win for a win to give up Julius for Kat. Both of those guys are very, very skilled and very good.”

Paul George on Julius Randle, Oct 4, 2024. Source: The Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Karl-Anthony Towns, Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau:

“Julius Randle and Donte DiVincenzo added a lot to our team. We had a need at the center position…. To get a player of (Karl-Anthony Towns') stature was huge. You don’t get a player like that without giving good players up.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Karl-Anthony Towns, Donte DiVincenzo, Oct 3, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Josh Hart
item.description:
“But I think we have versatility, where we can play smaller at times because of OG’s ability to guard big. Julius and [Josh] Hart can guard big as well.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Josh Hart, Sep 17, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Channing Frye on Julius Randle
item.description:
“But that might not be every game. For me, Julius, he’s going to have to adjust quickly.”

Channing Frye on Julius Randle, Mar 1, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Donte DiVincenzo on Julius Randle
item.description:
Steve Popper:Donte DiVincenzo on Julius Randle:

“When you hear weeks not months obviously it’s a good sign. Being here this first year, what I know about Julius is he’s going to do everything possible to cut whatever the timeline is,he’s going to try to cut that down, try to get back.”

Donte DiVincenzo on Julius Randle, Jan 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @StevePopper.

item.title: Josh Hart on Julius Randle
item.description:
Fred Katz:Josh Hart on making up for Julius Randle's absence:

“I think it’s gonna be a collective (effort), unless between now and game time I can put on 45 pounds of mostly muscle.”

Josh Hart on Julius Randle, Jan 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Josh Hart on Julius Randle
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Josh Hart on optimism of Julius Randle recovering faster:

“That has us in good spirits that he's not going to be out too long. We have to stay afloat during that time. I think we have the pieces to do that.”

Josh Hart on Julius Randle, Jan 29, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle
item.description:
Thibs on Julius:

“He’s being smart right now, as are we. So we're gathering the information then we'll make a good decision once we have the information. I think that's a big part of decision making. to speculate before you have all the information would just speculation.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Jan 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Anthony Davis on DeMarcus Cousins, Julius Randle, Christian Wood, Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
“I was confused a lot. I was sliding back into the four during some possessions [and I heard], ‘AD, run corner!’ I forgot. So, it was good. Still figuring things out. Talking with the coaches and Jaxson and C-Wood about some things that I did with DeMarcus [Cousins] and Julius [Randle] back in New Orleans. So, it’s been good.”

Anthony Davis on DeMarcus Cousins, Julius Randle, Christian Wood, Jaxson Hayes, Oct 6, 2023. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Julius Randle
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Spo on the #Knicks expected to be without Julius Randle:

“It’s still going to come down to competition;they're gonna try to do what they do, and we're gonna try and do what we do.”

Erik Spoelstra on Julius Randle, Apr 30, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle
item.description:
“Obviously, he has a lot of say in it. The medical people have say in it, as well. So if he gets back the baseline that everyone is comfortable with, then he plays. “If not, I trust our medical people, I trust Julius, and we have more than enough. Sowe’re hopeful that he plays, but if he doesn’t, just get out there and get it done.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Apr 30, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle
item.description:
“That's what I love about Julius. He gives you everything that he has. There's 77 games, he sprains his ankle and then he works like crazy to get back, you know how important he is to the team, but to get back, to get ready to play -- our medical people did a great job, but that's all him. He was working around the clock on that, he still is. That's the challenge that we have and that's what I respect about him. And we just got to get ready for our next game.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Apr 23, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Josh Hart on Julius Randle, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
midseason acquisition Josh Hart said after the game.

“For [Randle], his first game back, I’m not sure what he did on the offensive side, but he was rebounding the ball, contesting shots. “Him and obviously [Brunson] just controlling the tempo, getting us into our sets, doing those kinds of things that sometimes don’t show up in the box score. Having them both back, and us being at full strength, it feels good.”

Josh Hart on Julius Randle, Jalen Brunson, Apr 16, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle
item.description:
Knicks coach Tom Thibodeau said after the game.

“Julius played in 77 games until he sprained his ankle. ... you're going to get everything he has. I knew if he could go, he would go. That's Julius.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Apr 16, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Josh Hart on Julius Randle, Jarrett Allen, Isaac Okoro
item.description:
“They don’t got Jarrett Allen. They don’t got [Isaac] Okoro. We don’t got [Julius Randle].Maybe some of the individual things you see on both sides and you get a feel for it. But I think both teams are going to play totally different.”

Josh Hart on Julius Randle, Jarrett Allen, Isaac Okoro, Apr 1, 2023. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Wally Szczerbiak on Julius Randle, Jalen Brunson, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Wally Szczerbiak on the Knicks pregame show last night:

“I want to apologize personally to Tyrese Haliburton. He's a wonderful young player, he's definitely in the All-Star conversation, along with guys like Julius Randle & Jalen Brunson.”

Wally Szczerbiak on Julius Randle, Jalen Brunson, Tyrese Haliburton, Dec 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Kevin Knox
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Interesting answer by Thibodeau when asked about Toppin-Randle frontcourt:

“Offensively you’re making up ground by having a smaller guy. And we can also do that with Kevin (Knox)....Kevin with Julius. It gives you more 3-point shooting, but you’re sacrificing some defense.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Kevin Knox, Oct 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Taj Gibson on Julius Randle
item.description:
“You look at the body of work Julius has put together on a night-to-night basis. Being really professional, especially in a tough market. People understand how tough it is to play in New York and bringing a winning mentality back to the Knicks. Julius has earned credit for the MVP race. He deserves it.”

Taj Gibson on Julius Randle, May 4, 2021. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Monty Williams on Julius Randle
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty Williams on Julius Randle:

“He's playing with a great deal of confidence...he's an All-Star, he's aggressive, he can shoot it, he can attack the basket.”

Monty Williams on Julius Randle, Apr 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.
